what: Acuity makes lighting. It is the largest North American maker of commercial lighting fixtures, and it also sells building management controls and the software that runs them.
customers: Electrical contractors and distributors fitting out commercial buildings, warehouses and public spaces.
money: indoor and outdoor commercial lighting fixtures and controls
building management systems and lighting controls software
moat: Specification: lighting is designed into a building by engineers, and Acuity's products are in the standard specifications that contractors bid from.
risks: Commercial construction activity sets demand and has been weak
Lighting is a mature market where unit growth is slow
$809M of debt, though against $636M of cash
opportunities: A 11.5% net margin and $748M of free cash flow on $4.6B of revenue, high for a fixtures maker
Revenue grew from $3.8B to $4.6B in two years
Analysts see about 16% upside, and the controls and software business earns far better margins than fixtures
watch: Lighting segment sales and the growth of Intelligent Spaces.
